name: After § 43
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 43a. Regrets the earlier attempts to exclude or impede the Republic of Cyprus from participating in COP31 meetings and events; underlines the importance of the full and effective participation of all EU Member States in COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, from 9 to 20 November 2026, as well as in relevant high-level events held in connection with the Conference, emphasising the importance of international multilateral processes;
